title: Server side schedule enforcer
description:
One constant issue is that the agents especially the lead agent just gets stuck and stops working.  We need a non-agent based program which programmatically monitors the queue, the workers, etc. and when it is stuck sends a message saying "GO!" to the lead

Builder result (server-monitor-mini, message #2334; Queue que_2d7b54c8dc191ed2 cycle1 revision3; Start qrr_475f5dc7e8ba3b62/event120; order #2280, owner source #2274; candidate 2ea73fbdefbcd87b0ca92715edc4bb3d26d07f4c on baseline d3fe502a38c062405d6a080bc7b5f729c8d9c4fc): Added deterministic server schedule monitor with durable fingerprint delivery/backoff state and directed GO! lead messages only; no lifecycle/Queue/task/approval mutation. Verification passed go test ./internal/monitor ./internal/store ./cmd/tailterm-hub, go vet same, and git diff --check. Full ./... was attempted twice but stalled in pre-existing cmd/tt tt.test beyond 50s and was stopped; no full-suite pass claimed. Item remains Open; no acceptance or deployment.


Correction result #2540 (server-monitor-mini; item rev3/order2352; source FAIL2419/#2507, authority #2521): commit 72ed7b5 Harden schedule monitor stall handling atop frozen 2ea73fb. Active Queue work becomes active_stale from durable Queue UpdatedAt even with fresh worker heartbeat; blocked/unknown eligibility is per-entry; persistent LastAttemptAt/FailureCount backs off failed deliveries; seven-day bounded notice retention/pruning plus operator docs and controlled-clock isolated coverage added. Notification-only contract preserved; no Queue/lifecycle/approval/relay/network/live-data/root/deploy changes. Focused go test ./internal/monitor ./internal/store ./cmd/tailterm-hub, go vet same, and git diff --check pass. Item remains Open pending independent review.
